But after following just 3 steps, I have become the best speaker in my college. First of all, download the PW Talk app on your phone. Number 1: Clear your basics. For that, there are short reels-like videos on the PW Talk app made by the Physicswallah team. Whenever you get free time, watch these instead of reels. Your basics will be cleared without any effort. Number 2: Practice smartly. Rote learning nouns, pronouns, or the dictionary will never make your English speaking good. On the PW Talk app, you will find exercises that teach you English used in real life. Practicing for just 10 to 15 minutes a day is enough. Number 3: Start speaking without fear. Start talking in English as much as possible. But speaking in front of friends brings the fear of making mistakes. That's why you can take the help of PW Talk app's AI teacher, who won't judge your mistakes and will teach you correct English. So you can practice basics, exercises, and real speaking all on one app. Download the PW Talk app now.] Speaker B: इंग्लिश स्पीकिंग सीखना है तो PW Talk ऐप अभी डाउनलोड करो। [If you want to learn English speaking, download the PW Talk app now.]
